Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 51, "heading": "I\nGRINGOIRE A PLUSIEURS BONNES IDÉES DE SUITE RUE DES BERNARDINS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u051-b0062", "target": "—И это всё, что вы о ней знаете?", "source_sha256": "da77b84445a6da04a6eda65ab7aea19a6308c7bb98e137423f799f8aff63569d", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u051-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5e858702d3801df2c6bc6b1832348c0c6e3f92ad738080d20e6dd190ed12b28a"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u051-b0063", "target": "—Погодите. Мне сказали, что она укрылась в соборе Парижской Богоматери и что там она в безопасности, и я в восторге, а выяснить, спаслась ли коза вместе с ней, мне не удалось, и это всё, что я об этом знаю.", "source_sha256": "3225715e76a581d7d3ba2b328bfb85abadcecd5c69a2782fde3051ea23e02419", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u051-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "552d56b2e37a477f3105d44ef616565563345fb24d716c5c48de7b70349a1fe9"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 10, "chapter": 1, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u051-b0064", "text": "—Je vais vous en apprendre davantage, cria dom Claude, et sa voix, jusqu'alors basse, lente et presque sourde, était devenue tonnante. Elle est en effet réfugiée dans Notre-Dame. Mais dans trois jours la justice l'y reprendra, et elle sera pendue en Grève. Il y a arrêt du parlement.", "sha256": "c274446c645c5690cb4bdaacae866cd3ce7826844faeca67a697a324e1c24a6b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3009], "source_xml_sha256": "8a747e1f5769548dbc50d4cbf77b25b35d32d5700ff4bf442d225d2fdc82e93e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0065", "text": "—Voilà qui est fâcheux», dit Gringoire.", "sha256": "6adc5f56489c065a1f60805bc1fa737dfea8ec71185486ff5736689205f57c62", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3010], "source_xml_sha256": "c2aa6cc87b29e595d4f3b30daa53394329280ba48fc51a708dec68645fbedaee", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0066", "text": "Le prêtre, en un clin d'œil, était redevenu froid et calme.", "sha256": "5d25a4ab60ad950c027dbb3c1ce27bc1f449f821e68ec19b2991275c00d8d0b5", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3011], "source_xml_sha256": "c1c189d07dda68cda464e5ddcd6895f9ce1b026bbb8f81061e243ef9ebcb3db7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0067", "text": "«Et qui diable, reprit le poète, s'est donc amusé à solliciter un arrêt de réintégration? Est-ce qu'on ne pouvait pas laisser le parlement tranquille? Qu'est-ce que cela fait qu'une pauvre fille s'abrite sous les arcs-boutants de Notre-Dame à côté des nids d'hirondelle?", "sha256": "811ed6f9cade03c1aadd46526d7bb44872c4feaa9ff0d0c6aa99a22f9c63ee50", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3012], "source_xml_sha256": "ed335a30edd07cbebbf2bd6a887635f71cb0f135577d7ff390db31bd0cfeab72", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0068", "text": "—Il y a des satans dans le monde, répondit l'archidiacre.", "sha256": "e3da5221c464a3a974610f4fcca21a6d6e065748c0fb4b42c8cbcd136d57c235", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3013], "source_xml_sha256": "b5f9020ed51638300c21563bfb021752a6b6b9625c110f584b848c2386ba79f1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0069", "text": "—Cela est diablement mal emmanché», observa Gringoire.", "sha256": "54e31090f562e968ac07770e0c8e783eaa8f75bd837f53c0b22cbbc7de933730", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3014], "source_xml_sha256": "917475ac5ce4efdd75004b05c8a6627517e91f925a93154406a06ab28b30cb15", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0070", "text": "L'archidiacre reprit après un silence:", "sha256": "d9b3e9057b1a92b020aea071b1d2ff9ecee2df3820fc646c30f4e29588603149", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3015], "source_xml_sha256": "879a7bdace8fcb143f35549f95e4b7278915bdb77bf1d3cf269fa950a0aa59f5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0071", "text": "«Donc, elle vous a sauvé la vie?", "sha256": "db34f93a5a620b4683062dfdd3a4de3e48ff9a83c068351d081c8cb498694177", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3016], "source_xml_sha256": "d9929c34db9c34df7e2b51a901c523b92b4cc448c3c0ca69ed66f6931078d4d7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0072", "text": "—Chez mes bons amis les truandiers. Un peu plus, un peu moins, j'étais pendu. Ils en seraient fâchés aujourd'hui.", "sha256": "76f635219bdd3361caf11454d99380e9da4a7756d303f99b1b51b51abf7f36a3", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3017], "source_xml_sha256": "68e8c6cb5788c7fcf48d9608286993b2edf029fcc131553f05701e6ce779afad", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0073", "text": "—Est-ce que vous ne voulez rien faire pour elle?", "sha256": "30522e5b15fd258f72da5b6b905e9b70dbd71fb4c580f74596813351c7faae42", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3018], "source_xml_sha256": "01d950a7d35ee77e6b266428df422a4edbeb8a00fc55bb65c15936de703323f3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0074", "text": "—Je ne demande pas mieux, dom Claude. Mais si je vais m'entortiller une vilaine affaire autour du corps?", "sha256": "488dcae1df52966ec51b24618fe8515b6be77e6b9c95d11b4d675cb6d91fa3bb", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3019], "source_xml_sha256": "c710bb90f85ea07a0fb930179ae2680b0f6db31c81124cc9314c92b9270f85bb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0075", "text": "—Qu'importe!", "sha256": "269321fa7d9f534eba9294df5fcf577d4a2a2625cb9e8d921f83732cac59a012", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3020], "source_xml_sha256": "cb174285d5099530a21fcacefb7bf941683c5555eff273830bbd57515802954e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0076", "text": "—Bah! qu'importe! Vous êtes bon, vous, mon maître! j'ai deux grands ouvrages commencés.»", "sha256": "aa6051358b38dcc86fd455850a58bfb0ad833289a4a412b345af69ac9933d504", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3021], "source_xml_sha256": "fdebb86b41277b7ee3eb0bd86404cbc938226cf862626369bae37dee6fe604be", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0077", "text": "Le prêtre se frappa le front. Malgré le calme qu'il affectait, de temps en temps un geste violent révélait ses convulsions intérieures.", "sha256": "6f1e34d9bfa40d1893afd9678f654f1d445c82a2d79116f3dad3e473128457e8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3022], "source_xml_sha256": "02c97df55a49271dc3831ab8cc14e785a4d1563503c43f8e2755dd22dd5c1502", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0078", "text": "«Comment la sauver?»", "sha256": "fae75adbebc62561b4da8b98820154d47b058a04ae5daaf31e7fa5006cf21252", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3023], "source_xml_sha256": "768c7658a867cfa4325d153e3e34a12ecada05850075062750e5a1076c18fe3d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0079", "text": "Gringoire lui dit: «Mon maître, je vous répondrai: [[I]]Il padelt[[/I]], ce qui veut dire en turc: [[I]]Dieu est notre espérance[[/I]].", "sha256": "71fcdc137d374729532360ee3b4f44755b9a5da565ae76edca5a30a0d3d50675", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3024], "source_xml_sha256": "178fcdf437859f29e1a336f0af99bae511bc69e937599b69cb6f63334f825e17", "emphasis_spans": 2, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0080", "text": "—Comment la sauver?» répéta Claude rêveur.", "sha256": "c3d2efb82eb9e783798cb00efdfc0d70731b1068974b861b1564dbd1dea19426", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3025], "source_xml_sha256": "5d1e11d6915a63fab801063c0af806ccaf5eb2822f825995c20ccc760d0fab74", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0081", "text": "Gringoire à son tour se frappa le front.", "sha256": "5a79d20231d68d3f7b43c318cf793a11433ef0fa4820db0ad42a0d1e7acf294b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3026], "source_xml_sha256": "c5341e9dfdf88a88700e91f6bb60e83e7d4e1fd14f78c7c55cd0053eca9cfbd9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0082", "text": "«Écoutez, mon maître. J'ai de l'imagination. Je vais vous trouver des expédients.—Si on demandait la grâce au roi?", "sha256": "b06766f7f3ec9bd93c560659c212eb591288e1566d4f3e429aba19d9636e8179", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3027], "source_xml_sha256": "35e23756a802d94972b7d221e827d030b79b2ce34b21bf629ffc34c5f1ecef46", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0083", "text": "—À Louis XI? une grâce?", "sha256": "3e596a7de79cb1fa869c9be0e526fcc643f90df68fc0a46e678d8aafaf488a9f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3028], "source_xml_sha256": "553235535382f5f227ba3f59516310669ca289ef89ca5885c87a958178c98a8e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0084", "text": "—Pourquoi pas?", "sha256": "b94a95c69a55a02510484bd336c74698837785c658bd60a5bae8f5b1ce96d3f8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3029], "source_xml_sha256": "14968efbb21185aba1d8f6815828094b45d25ee5b94c3b741d9a03fef76f251c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0085", "text": "—Va prendre son os au tigre!»", "sha256": "a2ad6305d5d293a3898d9190f3ade80972f039120fadc2db141d3841a29642fd", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3030], "source_xml_sha256": "dcf60e9a3885fdb9aabe6910d871e10a9d784a91858ba5aba3a03d923a5b872c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0086", "text": "Gringoire se mit à chercher de nouvelles solutions.", "sha256": "d768ce2dd6f935810ee2df26d1f6f6a1bdd87dac4d6bf58e52400c476d5dc6cb", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3031], "source_xml_sha256": "7a141dc84c932efff3206b319f65cfedb3c50f4cdf3a4b61b008c15424ade061", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0087", "text": "«Eh bien! tenez!—Voulez-vous que j'adresse aux matrones une requête avec déclaration que la fille est enceinte?»", "sha256": "9169241a29f95a5015b8c2bb480707c6e47f3a609ee8bdb65d834762d7e4ec76", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3032], "source_xml_sha256": "b9f426b6b2c0d8ea25ab33fb18db6ccda6cf6b1131b66be395e653cab72a5bc8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0088", "text": "Cela fit étinceler la creuse prunelle du prêtre.", "sha256": "55f92ae03f26db4580ce7f4ea4e6013847b27ac282b7ffa9eab414ecea56c454", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3033], "source_xml_sha256": "24774b7c11ff512c0155eba218f3f30803f4ac11835974b9d53b9d766822e7c1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0089", "text": "«Enceinte! drôle! est-ce que tu en sais quelque chose?»", "sha256": "c22715bb238c532353bdcc4db6d13bc894215ea209c814d6db75a6d49a944b2c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3034], "source_xml_sha256": "5f9d468d0f0e1a420d1efe408e99b8d7561a4b22963daffc4f52091c0a1f734e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0090", "text": "Gringoire fut effrayé de son air. Il se hâta de dire: «Oh! non pas moi! Notre mariage était un vrai [[I]]forismaritagium[[/I]][[N119]]. Je suis resté dehors. Mais enfin on obtiendrait un sursis.", "sha256": "42b20eb0e37bf05dba11f99a9400faa1bbb4ff71ea9638890580c66a300cc95f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3035], "source_xml_sha256": "1747c081dd8e6749f92a4673724a0a0301b8fcd856ee42e5537a76d2e084f996", "emphasis_spans": 1, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": ["[[N119]]"]}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0091", "text": "—Folie! infamie! tais-toi!", "sha256": "8a606d2e672b18c99dc7ce70a8c730166e56aca98daac326597b1dc2c4a5cfff", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3036], "source_xml_sha256": "89bc0dfc48112dc10e398435e5768773e31e0306971a73f168478e2872cf7ce3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0092", "text": "—Vous avez tort de vous fâcher, grommela Gringoire. On obtient un sursis, cela ne fait de mal à personne, et cela fait gagner quarante deniers parisis aux matrones, qui sont de pauvres femmes.»", "sha256": "1db32c8a42e483a255e39706b731c97a67314413737c3e2f3cc2b69208fc88a6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3037], "source_xml_sha256": "715681514ebf42b2c9546a31ae85a9d79fb449e3eb1d6719ad55fe177364fb86", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0093", "text": "Le prêtre ne l'écoutait pas.", "sha256": "fbd841fc5a1752295b7327450f9e0f797f935cba55d5ca6cd1c3431d130a9a55", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3038], "source_xml_sha256": "f66543e145ef350223fb27241151af8b77e5c416fe50a82c7684e4e7c5860c89", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0094", "text": "«Il faut pourtant qu'elle sorte de là! murmura-t-il. L'arrêt est exécutoire sous trois jours! D'ailleurs, il n'y aurait pas d'arrêt, ce Quasimodo! Les femmes ont des goûts bien dépravés!» Il haussa la voix: «Maître Pierre, j'y ai bien réfléchi, il n'y a qu'un moyen de salut pour elle.", "sha256": "e073bcee894ebc9457596a05dfce1fb8adb51c517b6f301df00e047c88ccd0a3", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3039], "source_xml_sha256": "a3983ffbfd829865295fdb4471c2d5d3e960f5fd1c564460cd8f4157525bfe49", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0095", "text": "—Lequel? moi, je n'en vois plus.", "sha256": "6e91d491afc2ee1b948471aa7d27ec561d2bfa82dab5716a5d43fa7b635a40f9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3040], "source_xml_sha256": "f6befc95cc4ad49e7dc41e61ebb7bcf7193080f94b95f0ed0bf18da7691a23ed", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
